title: Keto Larb-Style Stir Fry with Mentaiko
description: A spicy and savory low-carb stir fry, inspired by the flavors of larb, featuring mentaiko and a bold Thai-inspired sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the pork and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut oil to the skillet.
Add the Thai basil and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the crushed mentaiko and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Return the pork to the skillet and stir in the fish sauce, lime juice, and chili flakes (if using).
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the pork is coated in the sauce and heated through.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional Thai basil if desired.
